Apply for this job

Fixture Robotics designs autonomous mobile manipulators that work alongside people in warehouses and research labs. Our controls team owns everything between the planner and the motors.

As a Robotics Controls Engineer you will design, tune and ship whole-body controllers for our arm-on-base platform, working closely with hardware, perception and planning teams.

What you'll do

  • Develop real-time control software in C++ for 7-DoF manipulators.
  • Model and identify robot dynamics; tune impedance and force controllers.
  • Build simulation tests and validate controllers on hardware.

What you'll bring

  • MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years of experience with robot control on real hardware.
  • Strong C++ and familiarity with ROS 2.
